reference.title: Scenario 2 — Generic Topic: Empty <shortdesc> (No Intro Paragraph)
reference.shortdesc: Scenario 2 — Generic Topic: Empty <shortdesc> (No Intro Paragraph) A section titled "Known Limitations

section.p: A section titled "Known Limitations in Version 4.2" opens directly with a bulleted list — no introductory Normal paragraph precedes it. Because there is no eligible paragraph to extract, the <shortdesc> element is written empty and flagged by the validator at WARNING severity.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Known Limitations in Version 4.2 [List Bullet]: Auto-duplex not supported above 200 gsm. [List Bullet]: Wi-Fi Direct limited to four simultaneous connections. [List Bullet]: Scheduled jobs not preserved across firmware updates.

entry.codeblock:
Known Limitations in Version 4.2
  • Auto-duplex not supported above 200 gsm.
  • Wi-Fi Direct limited to four simultaneous connections.
  • Scheduled jobs not preserved across firmware updates.

section.p: Result:Empty <shortdesc> and a validator WARNING. To fix: add an introductory Normal paragraph before the bullet list in the source document and rerun conversion or add the <shortdesc> text manually in the DITA output.
section.note: It is recommended to precede lists with a brief introductory paragraph that explains the purpose or context of the list.
